messages:
maria: Quick heads-up: we have a planned maintenance window tonight 23:45-00:45 UTC to perform a coordinated NIC micro-retry and BMC handshake on racks helios-03 and helios-04 (us-east1). Expect brief rolling reboots and soft cordons.

dev: How big an impact on GPU capacity? any Dedicated pools affected?

maria: Peak GPU capacity loss ~6-9% for ~20-40m while we warm-backfill. Dedicated pools are pinned but some workloads may see increased queuing; we'll avoid kicking off long jobs on these racks.

ram: Proposed sequence: cordon -> drain low-priority pods -> soft reboot -> run nvlink sanity -> run kv seed (2min) -> uncordon. Stagger nodes by 6m. Two parallel streams across racks but avoid same hostgroup concurrency.

maria: Runbook link: /runbooks/infra/helios-nic-microretry.md. I'll own execution. ops-bot: create an incident stub and set paging thresholds.

ops-bot: Incident stub created: INC-20240219-1711112222. Page oncall if error-rate > 8% for 10m or p95 latency > 3x.

dev: Tenant comms? any customer-facing note needed for Dedicated? Probably just top 3 tenants and any running long seq jobs.

maria: I'll notify oncall-customer-success for top tenants. No billing changes expected. Add scheduler rule to avoid scheduling seq>512 tokens on helios racks for 60m after maintenance.

ram: After each node boot, checklist: `nvidia-smi -L`, `journalctl -k -n100`, `nvlink-health --quick`, probe perf for 2m. If any nvlink issue, mark node for deeper diag and skip uncordon.

ops-bot: Tagging action queued: `tag-rack helios-03 helios-04 maintenance=1711112222` to be applied at start.

maria: I'll post status updates every 8m here. If rollback needed, I'll call it and abort next nodes. Thanks.

dev: All ok from infra-side. I'll mute non-critical alerts and keep watch on traffic shifts.

ram: Also increase kv cache seed rate by 1.5x during warmbackfill to reduce cold-cache tails.

maria: Good call. rolling start 23:45 UTC. will follow up with a short postmortem link after window. :wave:
